Hansard is the official report of what was said in the House of Assembly.

Hansard Reporting Services is responsible for the compilation of a complete and accurate verbatim report of the debates of the House of Assembly, and of the proceedings of committees of the House as may be required both when the House is in session and between sessions. The Manager of Hansard and Editor of Debates is Melany Close.
